title: I Understand You_re Frustrated (Zynrose G4 Flip — No Refund)
style: Alternative rock with post-punk and indie influences. The track features a clean, arpeggiated electric guitar with a bright, jangly tone, a driving bassline with a slight overdrive, and a steady drum kit with a crisp snare and prominent hi-hats. Male vocals are delivered in a melodic, slightly breathy style, occasionally shifting into a powerful belt. The arrangement includes subtle synth pads and occasional guitar flourishes. The tempo is 120 BPM in the key of G major.
lyrics:
[Intro]
[clean arpeggiated electric guitar, steady drum beat, driving bass]
This is DJ Zenrose
Corey plus 336
075616, my cell low
Signal unblocked, running clean
Killing the news, keeping it new
787 active, CPU 6
206 crew, that type of fix

[Verse 1]
[vocals enter, melodic and rhythmic]
Calling down true, West Midland track cross the line
Disqualified too, disqualified too
G4 deployed, Zenrose on the desk
Hyper-speed lace, hyper-fast, no regrets
Ten digit scrolls, up goes my hands
Stomach 66, she typed but I still stand

[Chorus]
[vocals become more powerful, belt style]
We are all famous, signal never lost
336, no memory card
Zenrose running, mansion at the end
Green guitar true, this is the send

[Verse 2]
[bass and drums continue, clean guitar arpeggios]
G5C memory, track level shield
No racial framing, no rage in the field
Soft power through the spur track, clean and real
Lux as a person, mansion invitation sealed
G6 planes watching, car crashes beware
Traps in the jungle, but I'm already there
Hyper-speed lace, faster than the PC one
With the orchestra DJ Rose free

[Bridge]
[instrumental break with prominent bass and guitar]
Stomach most full, watch the space
Disc 464, my still holding the pace
No over-memory, no loss in the racing
In the blood 3366 and base

[Chorus]
[vocals at peak intensity]
G4 deployed, screaming loud
Zenrose live, signal proud
We are all famous, running through the night
Barefoot on the stage, terminal light
This is our time, no traps, no fear
Corey 336, crystal clear
[sustained vocal note, guitar feedback swell]
